guest_completion_trace.report_text: A second probe traced the stock guest kernel on the corrected VMM. It paired 5,666 workspace completion work items with a median enqueue-to-execution delay of 1 µs and p95 of 2 µs. Median complete guest request times were 14 µs for OPEN, 10 µs for READ and 7 µs for RELEASE. Per-CPU loss counters were zero. A higher-priority completion queue could only recover the scheduling portion. These observations favor reducing request count while preserving edit visibility over changing the default workqueue priority. The first trace instance failed during setup. The second verified its selected clock and captured the raw timestamps and loss counters.

timing_scope.host_ms: Host edit through host observation of the guest completion marker, including polling and guest validation
timing_scope.host_edit_ms: Host edit through return of the host file operation
timing_scope.after_edit_ack_ms: Return of the host file operation through host observation of the guest completion marker
timing_scope.stat_ms: Guest lexical directory walk and file stat
timing_scope.read_ms: Guest open, read and hash of every file in walk order

timing.gap_releases_before: additional RELEASE requests between phases, outside opcode totals
timing.guest_elapsed_ns: monotonic guest interval, excluding phase markers and close drain
timing.host_handler_ns: sum of guest descriptor handlers, excluding injected pause and used-ring publish
timing.host_to_used_ns: sum from handler entry to used-ring publication, excluding injected pause
timing.span_ns: host monotonic interval between the two marker replies reaching the used ring
